description: Delete a scheduled event. If it is running, it ends in running rooms within ~15 seconds (its config overrides drop away; server logic gets onLiveOps with it in change.ended). To end it early but keep it listed, schedule the same id again with endsAt set to the current time.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

name: cancel_live_event
